coveragePolicy.granularity: map plugin and skill families to UIXAppTTR surfaces before activation
coveragePolicy.outputRequirement: Every activation must leave code, a report, a status marker, or a handoff note.
coveragePolicy.dependencyPolicy: No runtime dependency may be added without rollback, quality gates, and product route.

capabilities.label: Repository governance and GitHub operations
guardrails: Keep main protected.
Keep all implementation work inside UIXAppTTR.
Use connector markers while local gh auth is unavailable.
Do not force-push or overwrite remote-only server files.

capabilities.label: Frontend design, browser validation, and UI polish
guardrails: Preserve premium calm UI hierarchy.
Do not start heavy browser runs unless visual verification is needed.
Keep text readable on mobile and desktop.
Prefer existing design tokens and local patterns.

capabilities.label: Creative design and asset workflow
guardrails: Do not copy legacy assets blindly.
Extract only valuable, licensed, and product-relevant assets.
Keep visual density calm and purposeful.
Document asset origin when it affects reuse.

capabilities.label: Motion, 3D, cinematic web, and video systems
guardrails: Reduced motion support is mandatory.
Keep mobile performance ahead of spectacle.
Avoid heavy WebGL or video generation until a concrete surface needs it.
Every cinematic effect must support comprehension.

capabilities.label: Cloud hosting, server upload, and deployment
guardrails: Blocked until server target, document root, access method, and rollback path are explicit.
No live deploy from guesswork.
Prefer static package and dry-run handoff before upload.
Record every publication attempt.

capabilities.label: Security, compliance, dependency, and supply-chain checks
guardrails: Never expose secrets.
Do not add dependency bloat.
Prefer static checks before network-heavy scans.
Security findings must be actionable and scoped.

capabilities.label: AI workflow, knowledge, and documentation systems
guardrails: Translate large prompts into scoped tasks.
Keep AI actions transparent and auditable.
Do not create duplicate automation loops.
Preserve human review for high-risk changes.

capabilities.label: Polyglot and cross-platform app lanes
guardrails: Many languages stay contract-first until a real product route exists.
Do not promote a language lane into a service without server target.
Keep examples small, readable, and dependency-free.
Prefer PWA-first until native need is documented.

capabilities.label: Data, analytics, monitoring, and observability
guardrails: No analytics SDK until privacy and product route are clear.
Prefer documentation and taxonomy before instrumentation.
Keep monitoring useful, not noisy.
Do not collect unnecessary user data.

capabilities.label: Backend, database, API, and integration foundations
guardrails: No database provisioning until the product route is explicit.
Keep credentials out of source control.
Prefer contracts and local stubs before live services.
Document rollback and migration risk.

rules: Every capability must resolve to an existing plugin-skill registry surface.
Every registry surface must have at least one capability family.
High-risk capability families must not auto-activate.
Cloud deployment remains blocked until the target is explicit.
All plugin and skill output must stay inside UIXAppTTR.
